no_adcom_quote.quote: The application was not referred to an FDA advisory committee because it did not raise significant safety or efficacy issues in the intended population. However, the application was discussed independently with two SGE's. Both recommended approval.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for XALKORI (crizotinib) NDA202570. The Office Director memo, Cross-Discipline Team Leader review, and Medical Review all state the application was not referred to an AC; the ODMemo explains it did not raise significant safety or efficacy issues in the intended population, and instead the FDA findings were discussed independently with two Special Government Employees, both of whom recommended approval. Because no committee met, there are no committee-driven linkages to the approval.
